import json
rules = []
def add(p, r): rules.append([p, r])

# ---------- FEN -> internal ----------
for n in range(8, 0, -1):
    add(r'%d(?=\S* w )' % n, '.' * n)
add(r'/', '//')
add(r' w ', '// w ')
add(r'^(\S+) w (\S+) (\S+).*$', r'Z\2 \3:\1')
FL = 'KQkq'
def subsets():
    for m in range(16):
        s = ''.join(FL[i] for i in range(4) if m >> (3 - i) & 1)
        flags = ''.join('1' if m >> (3 - i) & 1 else '0' for i in range(4))
        yield (s or '-'), flags
for s, f in subsets():
    add(r'\AZ' + s + ' ', 'Z' + f)
for i, ch in enumerate('abcdefgh'):
    add(r'\A(Z....)' + ch + '6:', r'\g<1>' + str(i + 1) + ':')

# ---------- move generation ----------
BASE = 7
def off(r, c): return BASE + 10 * r + c
FK, FQ, Fk, Fq, EP = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
def rule(conds, writes):
    conds = dict(conds); writes = dict(writes)
    conds[0] = 'Z'; writes[0] = 'Y'
    if EP not in writes: writes[EP] = '-'
    P = sorted(set(conds) | set(writes))
    pat = r'\A'; rep = []; g = 0; last = -1; gid = {}
    for p in P:
        gap = p - last - 1
        if gap > 0:
            g += 1; pat += '(.{%d})' % gap; rep.append(('g', g))
        g += 1; pat += '(' + conds.get(p, '.') + ')'; gid[p] = g; rep.append(('p', p))
        last = p
    g += 1; pat += '(.*)'; rep.append(('g', g))
    out = r'\g<0>' + '\n'
    for kind, v in rep:
        if kind == 'g': out += r'\g<%d>' % v
        else:
            if v in writes:
                w = writes[v]
                out += (r'\g<%d>' % gid[w[1]]) if isinstance(w, tuple) else w
            else:
                out += r'\g<%d>' % gid[v]
    add(pat, out)

TGT = '[.pnbrq]'
def flag_updates(s, t, w):
    if s == (7, 0): w[FQ] = '0'
    if s == (7, 7): w[FK] = '0'
    if t == (0, 0): w[Fq] = '0'
    if t == (0, 7): w[Fk] = '0'
inb = lambda r, c: 0 <= r < 8 and 0 <= c < 8
for r in range(8):
    for c in range(8):
        s = (r, c); so = off(r, c)
        # knight
        for dr, dc in [(1,2),(2,1),(-1,2),(-2,1),(1,-2),(2,-1),(-1,-2),(-2,-1)]:
            if inb(r+dr, c+dc):
                t = (r+dr, c+dc); w = {so: '.', off(*t): 'N'}; flag_updates(s, t, w)
                rule({so: 'N', off(*t): TGT}, w)
        # king
        for dr in (-1, 0, 1):
            for dc in (-1, 0, 1):
                if (dr or dc) and inb(r+dr, c+dc):
                    t = (r+dr, c+dc); w = {so: '.', off(*t): 'K', FK: '0', FQ: '0'}; flag_updates(s, t, w)
                    rule({so: 'K', off(*t): TGT}, w)
        # sliders
        for dirs, cls in [([(0,1),(0,-1),(1,0),(-1,0)], '[RQ]'), ([(1,1),(1,-1),(-1,1),(-1,-1)], '[BQ]')]:
            for dr, dc in dirs:
                k = 1
                while inb(r+dr*k, c+dc*k):
                    t = (r+dr*k, c+dc*k)
                    conds = {so: cls, off(*t): TGT}
                    for j in range(1, k): conds[off(r+dr*j, c+dc*j)] = r'\.'
                    w = {so: '.', off(*t): ('copy', so)}; flag_updates(s, t, w)
                    rule(conds, w); k += 1
        # pawns
        if 1 <= r <= 6:
            nr = r - 1; pc = 'Q' if nr == 0 else 'P'
            rule({so: 'P', off(nr, c): r'\.'}, {so: '.', off(nr, c): pc})
            if r == 6:
                rule({so: 'P', off(5, c): r'\.', off(4, c): r'\.'}, {so: '.', off(4, c): 'P', EP: str(c + 1)})
            for dc in (-1, 1):
                if inb(nr, c+dc):
                    t = (nr, c+dc); w = {so: '.', off(*t): pc}; flag_updates(s, t, w)
                    rule({so: 'P', off(*t): '[pnbrq]'}, w)
                    if r == 3:
                        rule({so: 'P', off(*t): r'\.', off(3, c+dc): 'p', EP: str(c+dc+1)},
                             {so: '.', off(*t): 'P', off(3, c+dc): '.'})
# castling
rule({FK: '1', off(7,4): 'K', off(7,5): r'\.', off(7,6): r'\.', off(7,7): 'R'},
     {FK: '0', FQ: '0', off(7,4): 'K', off(7,5): 'K', off(7,6): 'K', off(7,7): '.'})
rule({FQ: '1', off(7,4): 'K', off(7,3): r'\.', off(7,2): r'\.', off(7,1): r'\.', off(7,0): 'R'},
     {FK: '0', FQ: '0', off(7,4): 'K', off(7,3): 'K', off(7,2): 'K', off(7,0): '.'})

# ---------- filter positions with attacked white king ----------
def chain(a, b, d, pcs):
    # a ... b with step d (forward), empties between
    if d == 1: return a + r'\.*' + b
    return a + r'(?:.{%d}\.)*.{%d}' % (d - 1, d - 1) + b
alts = []
for d, pcs in [(1, '[rq]'), (10, '[rq]'), (9, '[bq]'), (11, '[bq]')]:
    alts.append(chain('K', pcs, d, pcs)); alts.append(chain(pcs, 'K', d, pcs))
for d in (8, 12, 19, 21):
    alts.append('K.{%d}n' % (d-1)); alts.append('n.{%d}K' % (d-1))
for d in (1, 9, 10, 11):
    g = '.{%d}' % (d-1) if d > 1 else ''
    alts.append('K' + g + 'k'); alts.append('k' + g + 'K')
alts.append('p.{8}K'); alts.append('p.{10}K')
add(r'\nY[^\n]*?(?:' + '|'.join(alts) + r')[^\n]*', '')
# fix castling temp kings
add(r'(?m)^(Y.{%d})KKK' % (off(7,4) - 1), r'\g<1>.RK')
add(r'(?m)^(Y.{%d})KKK' % (off(7,2) - 1), r'\g<1>KR.')
add(r'\AZ[^\n]*\n?', '')

# ---------- internal -> FEN ----------
add(r'(?m)^Y(....)(.):(.*)$', r'\3 b \1 \2 0 0')
for s, f in subsets():
    add(' b ' + f + ' ', ' b ' + s + ' ')
for i, ch in enumerate('abcdefgh'):
    add(r'(?m) b (\S+) %d 0 0$' % (i + 1), r' b \1 ' + ch + '3 0 0')
add('//', '/')
add('/ b ', ' b ')
for n in range(8, 0, -1):
    add(r'\.{%d}' % n, str(n))
json.dump(rules, open('/tmp/obench-cell-4_je8ndb/bench_opencode_regex-chess_re610z4t/re.json', 'w'))
print(len(rules))
